title: Breach Kind Groups Resource
description: Introduce statute groups as a new resource. Replace path-based statute tree with explicit Territory document. Groups have name, description, scopes (glob filters applied general-to-specific). Groups can contain statutes or other groups as children. Update IDs, URIs, policies, trees, GraphQL schema, MCP tools, CLI commands, and tests.
summary: Introduced Territory as hierarchical intermediate tree item in policy system. Refactored PolicyDef to use Groups instead of flat Kinds. Updated GraphQL schema/resolvers, CLI tree rendering, and all tests. Fixed pre-existing test failures from concurrent dev changes (fixture files, section requirements removal, test file detection, file ID emoji changes).
